verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack and brand intact, but it is a shrunk portrait layout rather than a true banner rearrangement. Everything is packed into the top two-thirds and leaves a big dead band above the tiny legal line, and the three-line headline runs very wide. B breaks the design: the dark header bar is cut off halfway across, the orange divider is stranded alone on the empty right half, and the legal text floats at bottom-right away from everything else. The right half is almost blank, so the layout is badly lopsided.
